title: Evaluating AI for content credibility
description: Can a more elaborate AI system make better judgments? I led a three-person team combining ML signals and LLM agents, then compared designs across six credibility dimensions. Validation favored the simpler design.
takeaway: An evidence-led choice between simpler and more complex designs.

title: What goes into a recipe rating?
description: I investigated sugar content and recipe ratings through data cleaning, permutation testing, and Random Forest modeling. Feature engineering and tuning improved reported F1 from 0.87 to 0.92.
takeaway: From a statistical question to an evaluated prediction pipeline.

title: The secret life of blood glucose
description: How do you make continuous sensor data understandable? I co-developed a Python and JavaScript pipeline and interactive story that let readers explore glucose patterns, meals, and participant groups.
takeaway: An interactive explanation built around real time-series data.

title: PosturePress: Sleep Posture Pressure Visualization
description: Converted 221 pressure-sensor text files into analysis-ready matrices and built interactive D3.js contour maps to explore how pressure changes across sleep positions. Received a Best Project Award.

title: Washington State EV Adoption Analysis
description: Led a team exploring more than 210K Washington vehicle registrations. Used statistical analysis and visualization to investigate regional patterns in electric-vehicle adoption, pricing, and range.

title: Interest Zoning
description: An event-discovery product concept shaped by research with 45 participants. Translated behavioral insights into requirements, prototypes, and iterations on matching and onboarding.
